two_bugs_found_and_fixed.symptom: 1.265e-04 relative drift in D_S across epoch binades 2^0-2^36 s
two_bugs_found_and_fixed.cause: t_b - t_obs_s subtracted two large absolute epochs; precision lost when t_b was CONSTRUCTED (t_tx + light_time_B), not at the final subtraction
two_bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: D_S = forward.light_time_s - backward.light_time_s (two small local quantities)

two_bugs_found_and_fixed.location: FD verification harness (Jacobian and K-sensitivity checks)
two_bugs_found_and_fixed.symptom: state Jacobian max rel err 3.11e-04 (marginal fail); K-sensitivity E2E rel err 37.3 (sign unstable, catastrophic fail)
two_bugs_found_and_fixed.cause: crude piecewise-linear position interpolation in the FD harness vs the qualified cubic-Hermite interpolator the analytic path uses; d(D_S)/dK's true signal (~3.5e-15 s at the tested FD step) sat far below the linear interpolant's own ~1e-7 s absolute truncation-error floor
two_bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: rebuilt every position/velocity lookup in the FD harness on the same Hermite interpolator (_interp_state) the analytic path uses; station velocity taken from the qualified 6x6 J2000/ITRF93 transform directly
two_bugs_found_and_fixed.result_after_fix: state Jacobian rel err 6.78e-06; K-sensitivity E2E rel err 8.21e-05

anchor_convention_reconciliation.issue: governing spec s17 diagrams a transmit-anchored DDOR; Moyer Section 11.4.1 anchors on common reception time instead
anchor_convention_reconciliation.resolution: shipped implementation follows the spec's transmit-anchored HARD requirement literally; independently cross-checked against Moyer's reception-anchored convention using zero new solver code
anchor_convention_reconciliation.conclusion: Jacobian vectors nearly PARALLEL (uniform ~3.3e-4 scale offset), so f_perp/theta_K are unaffected by the anchor choice; the negative finding is robust to it
